name: Jest to Vitest Migration Pack
trustedExecutionNote: Packs execute shell commands (perStepTypecheckCmd, checkpointTestCmd, snapshot commands). Only load trusted packs.
knownLimitations: Vitest and Jest APIs are largely compatible, but `jest.requireActual`, custom transformers, and Jest-specific `testEnvironment` settings have no direct Vitest equivalent and require manual review.
Test-count parity is verified by executing the runner-agnostic wrapper; tests skipped via `.skip`/`.todo` are not counted as dropped.

packageDetectors.description: Confirms the target is a Jest (TypeScript) test project.

detectionRules.description: Jest API calls: jest.fn(), jest.mock(), jest.spyOn(), jest.clearAllMocks(), jest.useFakeTimers(), and mock lifecycle helpers.
Jest type references: jest.Mock<...>, jest.SpyInstance<...>, jest.MockedFunction<...>.

agentGuidance.MIGRATE: Replace Jest APIs with Vitest: `jest.fn()` → `vi.fn()`, `jest.mock(path)` → `vi.mock(path)`, `jest.spyOn` → `vi.spyOn`, `jest.useFakeTimers` → `vi.useFakeTimers`. Add `import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest'` when those names are used. Replace `jest.Mock<T>`/`jest.SpyInstance<T>` type annotations with `Mock<T>`/`MockInstance<T>` imported from 'vitest'. Remove any `import { ... } from '@jest/globals'`. Do NOT include any `// @bkb-shim` comments.
agentGuidance.SHIM: This module (typically a shared test helper or mock factory) has unmigrated upstream callers (`pendingCallersCount > 0`). Export a runner-agnostic accessor: `const getMock = () => (typeof globalThis.vi !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.vi : (globalThis as any).jest); // @bkb-shim`. Tag ONLY the legacy `(globalThis as any).jest` fallback line with `// @bkb-shim` so it can be removed during DE_SHIM.
agentGuidance.DE_SHIM: All upstream callers are now migrated (`pendingCallersCount == 0`). Replace the runner-agnostic `getMock()` accessor with direct `vi` usage and remove every `(globalThis as any).jest` fallback and `// @bkb-shim` comment so the module depends on Vitest only.

invariants.description: Every test/describe title declared in this file must match baseline_sets so no test cases are dropped during migration.
